content:
Black case: all rooks on black cells require a permutation preserving parity of rows/columns. There are 5 odd rows/columns and 4 even rows/columns, so
\[
5!\cdot 4! = 120\cdot 24 = 2880.
\]
White case: all rooks on white cells would require a parity-reversing permutation, sending 5 odd rows to only 4 even columns, which is impossible. Thus count is 0.

Total:
\[
2880+0=2880.
\]

\boxed{2880}
